ALL-DAY CRAFT FAIR
Come browse the offerings of
local independent artisans at
Raymond University Student
Center on November 15,
9 A.M-5 P.M. and start your
holiday shopping!
Vendors will display their
handmade jewelry, ceramics,
textiles, and other craft items.
